item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-05
item.description:
Our community has seen a flurry of activity across multiple projects, with notable updates in `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing`, `lhdjung/scrutiny`, `quest-bih/oddpub`, `giladfeldman/docpluck`, and `shaheedazaad/auto-zcurve`. The `tenzing` and `scrutiny` projects both received updates to their deployment and user interface, with `tenzing` releasing version 0.4.1 and `scrutiny` deploying to `gh-pages` twice. Meanwhile, `oddpub` enhanced its ontogenerator with new detection capabilities, and `docpluck` made significant updates to its documentation, including the introduction of a "TRIPLE AI VERIFICATION hard rule". Additionally, `auto-zcurve` addressed security and installer issues, demonstrating the community's commitment to resolving specific problems and improving overall functionality. These updates highlight the connections between our projects and celebrate the progress being made across the community.

75 commits across 7 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.2

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

item.title: docpluck: 34 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the `main` branch, where the documentation was updated to reflect a cross-project adjudication verdict being upheld, with the mechanism refuted, as stated in the commit message "docs(audit): DP-3 cross-project adjudication — verdict upheld, MECHANISM REFUTED". The documentation was also updated to include a "TRIPLE AI VERIFICATION hard rule" and to re-audit every prior "won't-fix" issue, as per the commit message "docs: TRIPLE AI VERIFICATION hard rule + re-audit of every prior won't-fix". Additionally, various handoff documents were updated, including recording cycle-1 Phase 5d verdicts, the eta-squared adjudication, the cycle-4 structural verdict on the plos_med column loss, and the cycle-3 gate state and canary evidence. A new rule, "20a — how to survey, and when a survey cannot help", was also added as part of the "docpluck-iterate" effort. Furthermore, a fix was implemented to "refuse a sign flip against a CI that cannot hold a negative" in the `normalize` module, as stated in the commit message "fix(normalize): refuse a sign flip against a CI that cannot hold a negative (v2.4.123)".

34 commit(s) today:

  • d2c10b8 [main] fix(normalize,sections): wrapped-CONTACT strip + KEYWORDS label/value split (v2.4.124) — Gilad Feldman
